summary: Adds a Retract threshold field with a 0/tool-diameter toggle button to the Profile, Pocket-based and Adaptive operation task panels, relabels Keep tool down ratio and Material allowance/Pass Extension to Retract threshold and Radial stock to leave, and converts several fields to expression-capable quantity spin boxes.

pages.reason: PageOpProfileFullEdit.ui / Profile.py: Operation panel gains 'Retract threshold' quantity field (RetractThreshold) plus toggle button setting it to 0 or OpToolDiameter; Number of passes becomes an expression-bound Gui::IntSpinBox

PageOpPocketFullEdit.ui / PocketBase.py: Operation panel gains 'Retract threshold' field and toggle button; 'Material allowance'/'Pass Extension' label replaced by 'Radial stock to leave'; Angle becomes a -180..180° spin box
PocketBase.py initPage/thresholdToggle apply to the MillFace task panel: new 'Retract threshold' field with toggle, 'Material allowance' label now 'Radial stock to leave'
PocketBase.py-derived 3D Pocket panel gains 'Retract threshold' field with toggle and 'Radial stock to leave' label from PageOpPocketFullEdit.ui

PageOpAdaptiveEdit.ui: label 'Keep tool down ratio' renamed to 'Retract threshold' and KeepToolDownToggle button added (sets KeepToolDownRatio to 0 or OpToolDiameter); Force inside-out / Use outline / Use rest machining checkboxes moved to a separate options block
Engrave does not use PocketBase.py or PageOpPocketFullEdit.ui; source-map candidate is spurious
Path/Base/Gui/Util.py adds internal helper refresh_expression_icon on QuantitySpinBox; nothing the workbench overview describes
